messages.en:
{07 15 00}I might be hunting for
fossils,{01 00 00 0a 00} but I'm not doing
it for money!
{06 01 00 03 04 05}
messages.et:
{07 15 00}Ma võin küll kivistisi
otsida,{01 00 00 0a 00} aga ma ei tee seda
raha pärast!
{06 01 00 03 04 05}

messages.en:
{07 00 00}If you dig up something
else when you're looking for
fossils,{01 00 00 05 00} don't panic, OK?
{07 15 00}Just ask yourself, "What
would {04 01 00} do in
this situation?"
{07 19 00}Just do the same,{01 00 00 05 00} and you'll
be all set, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!{07 00 00}

{07 16 00}I've heard{01 00 00 05 00} that the number
of fossils you'll find in
life{01 00 00 0a 00} is predetermined!
{07 0e 00}My calculations{01 00 00 0a 00} say that I
should be able to find
about three per day{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Olen kuulnud{01 00 00 05 00}, et kivististe
arv, mida elus leiad,{01 00 00 0a 00} on
ette määratud!
{07 0e 00}Minu arvutused{01 00 00 0a 00} ütlevad, et
peaksin leidma umbes
kolm päevas{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.

messages.en:
{07 14 00}I'm actually doing it so
{ff 00 00 06}Blathers {ff 00 00 00}will like me more,
{04 02 00}.
{07 1b 00}See, if {ff 00 00 06}Blathers{ff 00 00 00} doesn't
identify my fossil for me,{01 00 00 0a 00}
I can't sell it!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Teen seda tegelikult, et
{ff 00 00 06}Blathers {ff 00 00 00}mind rohkem
armastaks, {04 02 00}.
{07 1b 00}Näed, kui {ff 00 00 06}Blathers{ff 00 00 00} mu
kivistist ära ei tunne,{01 00 00 0a 00}
ei saa ma seda müüa!

messages.en:
{07 13 00}I do it so I can eat lots
and lots of delicious
{04 19 00}!
{07 11 00}You see, selling fossils
is simply the means that
allows me to do that!
messages.et:
{07 13 00}Teen seda selleks, et saaks
süüa palju-palju maitsvat
{04 19 00}!
{07 11 00}Näed, kivististe müük on
lihtsalt vahend, mis
seda võimaldab!

{07 00 00}Mu suur arm on {01 00 00 0f 00}haruldaste
kivististe otsimine{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{07 0a 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}ja
{04 0c 00} ees hooplemine.
